name: Ichijou Shinobu
source: Childhood friend to Seiichi, tall, short-spoken and serious. He lives close to Seiichi's grandfather's workshop. Forming a four people group after meeting Miyu. Seemingly relaxed, he only cuts his hair when it's too long. He lost his mother to the bloodsucker murderer a few years ago, swearing to uncover the truth behind it. Missed Seiichi after his family's relocation.
